source.title: On two open problems of 2-interval patterns

trace.notes: Normalized the input as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/5561689 for document identifier 5561689. Local workflow shard metadata identifies the exact work as 'On two open problems of 2-interval patterns', published in Theoretical Computer Science 410(24-25), pages 2410-2423, 2009, and records DOI 10.1016/j.tcs.2009.02.033.

Failure mode: metadata_only plus blocked_or_challenged. The zbMATH URL could not be fetched as a readable technical source in this environment. DBLP and local shard rows only provided bibliographic resolver metadata. Search recovery for the exact title and DOI found ScienceDirect/author-profile and ACM-style abstract snippets, DBLP table-of-contents metadata, and citing or related papers, but no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML article body containing the problem statements.

Bounded exact-work recovery attempts used the zbMATH identifier, exact title plus PDF, exact DOI plus PDF, exact title plus ScienceDirect PII, and exact title plus first author. Candidate pages were rejected when they were abstracts, citation metadata, table-of-contents pages, search snippets, citing papers, or related works rather than a readable copy of the same paper.

No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML artifact was available. The source-adequacy gate forbids extracting questions from zbMATH metadata, DBLP metadata, ScienceDirect author-profile abstracts, ACM-style abstract snippets, citation pages, search snippets, or related/citing papers.
No candidates were accepted because there were no verbatim problem-statement quotes with page numbers or stable HTML locators from a readable primary source artifact.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-5561689.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
